title: Mack Superliner FUPS Road Train Hi-tensile Aluminium Bullbar #24
description: Mack Superliner hi-tensile aluminium FUPS Bullbar. 88mm dia pipe, 100mm dia available. Reversible aluminium Road Train signs. Contoured lower main channel with indicator repeater & daylight running lights. One piece cross pipes passing through drilled uprights and recessed into drilled outer uprights, no but welds. Tow pin protector plate. Heavy duty steel backing plate with 38mm tow pin. Driving light or light bar mounts can be custom fitted to your requirements.
